name: Abstract
description: Abstract number in which the permit was filed. This is a location field.

name: AmendedDate
description: Date the permit application is amended by state agency.

name: API_UWI
description: API defined as: State (2 digit), county (3 digit), unique well identifier (5 digit) | UWI number is a unique well identifier (up to 16 digits) that defines the bottom-hole location and each significant drilling or completion event in the well.

name: API_UWI_Unformatted
description: API_UWI with dashes and slashes removed.

name: ApprovedDate
description: Date permit was approved.

name: Block
description: Block in which the permit was filed. This is a location field.

name: BottomHoleLatitude
description: Bottom hole latitude location of the matched permit.

name: BottomHoleLongitude
description: Bottom hole longitude location of the matched permit.

name: ContractorAddress
description: Drilling contractor contact address.

name: ContractorCity
description: Drilling contractor contact address.

name: ContractorContact
description: Drilling contractor contact name.

name: ContractorEmail
description: Drilling contractor contact email.

name: ContractorName
description: Drilling contractor that is associated with the rig.

name: ContractorPhone
description: Drilling contractor contact phone number.

name: ContractorState
description: Drilling contractor contact address.

name: ContractorWebsite
description: Drilling contractor contact website.

name: ContractorZip
description: Drilling contractor contact address.

name: Country
description: Name of Country.

name: County
description: Name of the county (USGS quad name in Alaska, Parish name for Louisiana).

name: DeletedDate
requirements: Value should be in the RFC3339 format. Example: 2021-01-01
description: Date the record was deleted.

name: DirectionsToLocation
description: Driving direction from county courthouse to the rig location

name: District
description: Associated district assigned by the Railroad Commission of Texas (RRC). This is a location field.

name: DrawWorks
description: Draw works of a rig. Reported by rig contractor.

name: ENVBasin
description: ENV Basin as defined by a well's location within one of 32 ENV Basin Shapefiles. Basins are defined by EIA Shapefiles and Enverus-defined geological prospectivity.

name: ENVGasGatherer
description: The closest gas gathering system to the well, based on Enverus shapefiles.

name: ENVGasGatheringSystem
description: The closest gas gathering system to the well, based on Enverus shapefiles.

name: ENVInterval
description: ENV Interval is assigned when a well is located within an ENV Play Shapefile boundary AND meets specific geo-gridding, date, trajectory and/or formation criteria to be considered prospective within that given play file boundary.

name: ENVOilGatherer
description: The closest oil gathering system to the well, based on Enverus shapefiles.

name: ENVOilGatheringSystem
description: The closest oil gathering system to the well, based on Enverus shapefiles.

name: ENVOperator
description: Latest operator of the well. Data has been normalized and standardized by Enverus to aggregate into single operator names as well as roll subsidiaries up to the parent company where public data is disclosed.

name: ENVPeerGroup
description: The respective group a company belongs based on market capitalization for public companies, and for private companies either private equity backed or non-private equity backed private distinctions.

name: ENVPlay
description: ENV Play as defined by a well's location within an Enverus-defined Play Shapefile AND meets criteria to be assigned an ENV Interval within that play.

name: ENVRegion
description: ENV Region as defined by a well's location within one of nine ENV Region Shapefiles. ENV Region inclusively covers North America.

name: ENVSubPlay
description: ENV Sub Play as defined by a well's location within an Enverus-defined Sub Play Shapefile. Sub Play is a subset of a play where all Sub Plays inclusively make up a play.

name: ENVTicker
description: Ticker symbol for the most recent reported operator based on Enverus-normalized ENV Operator field. Public companies follow the convention of "-US" for US-listed stocks and "-CA" for Canadian-listed stocks. Private operators are followed by an asterisk*.

name: ExpiredDate
description: Date of Permit Expiration.

name: Field
description: The name of the field in which the well is permitted.

name: H2SArea
description: Flag indicating that the well is subject to Statewide Rule 36 (hydrogen sulfide area). (TX only).

name: LandOffshore
description: Flag indicating the well is on land or in offshore region.

name: LeaseName
description: Name of the lease or well as defined by the operator on filing.

name: Mobility
description: The mobile capabilities of the rig: walking, sliding and skidding.

name: OperatorAddress
description: Operator contact address.

name: OperatorCity
description: Operator contact address.

name: OperatorCity30_MI
description: Aliased small operator cities to the nearest major city (within 30 mi) for easier identification of operators in a metro-area.

name: OperatorContact
description: Operator contact name.

name: OperatorPhone
description: Operator contact phone number.

name: OperatorState
description: Operator contact address.

name: OperatorZip
description: Operator contact address.

name: PermitNumber
description: Number assigned to the permit by the state agency.

name: PermittedMeasuredDepth_FT
description: Measured Depth (MD) to which the well is intended to be drilled.

name: PermittedOperator
description: The most recently reported operator obtained from the state document, permit, completion or production data source.

name: PermittedTrueVerticalDepth_FT
description: True Vertical Depth (TVD) to which the well is intended to be drilled.

name: PermittedWaterDepth_FT
description: Permitted Water Depth for offshore wells in the Gulf of Mexico.

name: PermitType
description: Specifies the permit type â€“ for example, Wildcat, Extension, or Amended.

name: PowerType
description: Drive mode of the rig: AC electric drive (AC), DC electric drive via silicon-controlled-rectifier (SCR), or mechanical drive (MECH).

name: Range
description: Number of the range in which the permit was filed. This is a location field. This is a location field.

name: RatedHorsePower
description: Rated horsepower of the rig.

name: RatedWaterDepth_FT
description: Rated water depth for offshore/inland water rigs; measured in ft.

name: RigClass
description: Indicates the horsepower category. There are five categories: A is less than 500, B is 500 to 999, C is 1,000 to 1,499, D is 1,500 to 1,999 and E is greater than or equal to 2,000 HP.

name: RigJobStartDate
description: The earliest date of a drilling event (job).

name: RigLatitude
description: Latitude of the rig measured in degrees. Reported by Enverus GPS Unit or taken from permit surface hole, or manual input (GPS, permit, customer, state agency, etc.)

name: RigLongitude
description: Longitude of the rig measured in degrees. Reported by Enverus GPS Unit or taken from permit surface hole, or manual input (GPS, permit, customer, state agency, etc.)

name: RigNameNumber
description: Concatenation of ENVERUS created abbreviation of contractor name and contractor assigned rig name/number.

name: RigType
description: Type of drilling rig. Reported by contractor.

name: Section
description: Number of the section in which the permit was filed. This is a location field.

name: SpudDate
description: The first recorded spud date / drilling start date of the well surface location.

name: StateProvince
description: Name of State or Province.

name: STR
description: Section Township Range.

name: SubmittedDate
description: Date of Permit Submission.

name: SurfaceLocationSource
description: Identification of the source of the rig surface location.

name: Survey
description: Survey name in which the permit was filed. This is a location field.

name: TargetFormation
description: The name of the formation in which the well is permitted.

name: Township
description: Number of the township in which the permit was filed. This is a location field.

name: Trajectory
description: Description for wellbore orientation.

name: UpdatedDate
requirements: Value should be in the RFC3339 format. Example: 2021-01-01
description: Date the record was updated.

name: WellID
description: Enverus-generated unique well identifier.

name: WellNumber
description: Number of wells.

name: WellType
description: Description of well type.

name: ENVRigID
description: Internal Enverus unique identifier for rig dataset.
